component.name: Atlas Notes
component.summary: Local-first notes and checklists with local AI

description.p: Atlas Notes keeps your notes as plain Markdown files on your own computer. It has checklists, links between notes, tags, tasks with due dates and reminders, version history, and an optional assistant that runs on a local Ollama server, so nothing leaves your machine.
Notes can be opened by Obsidian and any other Markdown app.
